answer_text: Hold Time is the number of seconds the system waits before declaring a BGP neighbor down. With a 10s Hold Time and a 30s Keep-alive, transient delays can cause the session to flap. You can adjust Hold Time and the Keep-alive Interval in the BGP Advanced Settings for the Cato Socket; the KB notes that these values can be changed (the Hold Time example includes 90). Consider increasing Hold Time to a more conservative value and ensuring the Keep-alive interval is appropriate for your link.
